name: Rogowski TI Gerber Coil Generator
description: TI Gerber-derived dual-winding Rogowski coil with selectable terminal nets and a bottom series link.
description_full: KiCad 10 dual-winding Rogowski coil using TI reference trace templates. Select two enabled copper layers; default F.Cu/B.Cu. Curves are native PCB_ARC tracks. Vias span the selected pair as through, blind or buried vias. Terminals on outer layers are SMD pads; terminals on inner layers are filled copper square graphics without pads or mask openings. Choose existing PCB nets or enter new names for terminals 1 and 2. Terminals 3 and 4 are intentionally joined on the second selected layer; no separate net inputs are provided. Outer-layer links use a net-tie footprint. Inner-layer copper graphics may produce DRC contact/short reports and need review. Generated items are grouped and focused after completion. Live preview supports wheel zoom, pan and parameter highlighting. See README for limitations.
